after-completing-monkey-madness-ii.npc: You have brought peace between our kingdoms, [player name].
I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.

using-a-big-banana-on-him.text: You show the banana to King Awowogei.

using-a-big-banana-on-him.npc: Now that's quite the banana. Where did you get it?

using-a-big-banana-on-him.player: Far from here, deep in the Kharidian Desert.

using-a-big-banana-on-him.text: You recount your experiences with the baboons in Osmumten's Tomb...

using-a-big-banana-on-him.npc: Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
Now that we know their story, you can rest assured that their memory will live on here.

using-a-big-banana-on-him.text: You give the banana to King Awowogei.

treasure-trails.npc: I need you to answer this for me.

treasure-trails.text: King Awowogei has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-when-spoken-to-again.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.npc: How can that be? Go check again!

steps.text: King Awowogei has given you another clue scroll/a casket!
